From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood-inference.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Commercial summary & timing check — Redwood proposal for ClearBridge

Hi Beatrice / Tom,

Thanks again for the time today — great to learn more about ClearBridge's ingestion pipeline and the 3 main LLM use-cases you highlighted (real-time summarization, customer intent rerank, and on-demand embeddings for search). Per our conversation, I attached a short commercial summary that maps the recommended deployment options to expected latency and cost ranges.

High-level recap:
- Recommended baseline: Redwood Dedicated (reserved pool) for consistent latency on real-time summarization; estimate assumes 8M tokens/mo.
- Fallback plan: Hosted API burst tier for ad-hoc spikes (auto-fallback configured).
- Security: Private deployment for PII workflows + KMS integration (optional add-on).

Attachments: commercial-summary-redwood-CLBR.pdf (2 pages; pricing bands + SLOs + next steps)

Next steps I suggested on the call:
1) Your review of the commercial summary
2) Quick 15-min walk-through with engineering + procurement to answer questions and lock an initial timeline

If you’re open to a walkthrough, here are a few slots I have this week:
- Tue 08/03 10:00–10:15 PT
- Tue 08/03 15:30–15:45 PT
- Wed 08/04 09:00–09:15 PT

Or feel free to pick a time directly: https://calendly.com/monica-patel/15min

I’ll follow up mid-week if I don’t hear back.

Thanks,
Monica
Monica Patel
